basics.description: EMP deploys and manages FileDS and BlockDS clusters. This creates the network for them, a compute gallery with the EMP image taken from the VHD warehouse, and the EMP virtual machine.

location.label: Region
location.toolTip: Pick a region with Premium SSD v2 if the clusters go in the same region. FileDS and BlockDS data disks are Premium SSD v2 only.

options.text: [concat('Ebdsv5 vCPU quota in ', location(), ': ', string(sub(first(filter(basics('usages').value, (u) => equals(u.name.value, 'standardEBDSv5Family'))).limit, first(filter(basics('usages').value, (u) => equals(u.name.value, 'standardEBDSv5Family'))).currentValue)), ' free of ', string(first(filter(basics('usages').value, (u) => equals(u.name.value, 'standardEBDSv5Family'))).limit), '. A cluster of three E8bds_v5 controllers needs 24. Nothing here uses it yet; it is for the clusters EMP deploys later.')]

elements.name: empName
elements.label: Virtual machine name
elements.toolTip: Also the host name. The public IP and NIC are named after it.

constraints.validationMessage: 2-15 letters, numbers and hyphens, starting with a letter.

elements.name: empSize
elements.label: Size
elements.toolTip: EMP and its performance collector fit in 2 vCPUs and 8 GiB.

elements.name: adminUsername
elements.label: Username
elements.toolTip: The Linux user on the EMP VM. EMP's own sign-in is created in the browser on first use.

toolTip.authenticationType: Password, or an SSH public key (password login is then off).
toolTip.password: At least 12 characters with three of: lower case, upper case, a digit, a symbol.
toolTip.sshPublicKey: An OpenSSH public key, e.g. ssh-ed25519 AAAA... user@host

options.text: The EMP image comes from the VHD warehouse: the newest emp-<version>.vhd (or the version you name) is copied into a small staging account in this resource group, published to a compute gallery here, and the staged copy is deleted. The copy and the image version take 10 to 20 minutes. Ask for a SAS with read and list on the container.

elements.name: warehouseAccount
elements.label: Warehouse storage account
elements.toolTip: The storage account holding the VHDs.

elements.name: warehouseContainer
elements.label: Container
elements.toolTip: The container with the emp-<version>.vhd blobs.

constraints.validationMessage: 3-63 lowercase letters, numbers and single hyphens.

elements.name: warehouseSas
elements.toolTip: A SAS with read and list on the container; with or without the leading ?. It is used during the deployment only.

constraints.validationMessage: Paste the SAS token: the query string with sv=, sp= and sig=.

elements.name: empVersion
elements.label: EMP version
elements.toolTip: latest takes the newest VHD in the container. Or name one, e.g. 0.20.0. EMP updates itself from its container registry later, so latest is usually right.

elements.name: galleryName
elements.label: Compute gallery name
elements.toolTip: Leave blank for gal_<resource group>. Gallery names are unique in a subscription. EMP adds the controller images to the same gallery later.

constraints.validationMessage: Letters, numbers, underscores and periods; no hyphens.

toolTip.virtualNetwork: A new network, or one that already exists in this region.
toolTip.subnets: Two subnets: management (EMP and the controllers' management NICs) and data (where clients mount and log in).

options.text: Each subnet gets its own NSG, attached to the subnet (none on NICs). Inside the network: SSH and HTTPS to management, NFS, SMB and iSCSI to data, DNS on both, and the cluster's own ports. From outside, only the addresses below get in.

An existing network is used as it is: its subnets and their NSGs are left alone. EMP needs HTTPS (443) in from wherever you open it, and SSH (22) and 443 to the controllers on the management subnet. Whoever deploys needs join rights on the subnet.

elements.name: adminSource
elements.label: Allow access from
elements.toolTip: Your public IP address (or a CIDR, or several separated by commas). Allowed in on every port to both subnets, as rule admin_any_in. Search the web for 'what is my IP' if you do not know it.

constraints.validationMessage: IPv4 addresses or CIDRs, separated by commas.

elements.name: publicIp
elements.label: Give EMP a public IP address
elements.toolTip: Untick when EMP is reached over a VPN or peering only.

elements.name: empPrivateIp
elements.label: EMP private IP
elements.toolTip: Leave blank for host 50 of the management subnet (e.g. 10.30.0.50).

constraints.validationMessage: An IPv4 address in the management subnet.
